title: fix: record baseline snapshot error field and improve session handling
prompt:
fix: record baseline snapshot error field and improve session handling

Add baseline_snapshot_error to PreTaskRecord and restore non_regression_strategy.
Handle approval key errors cleanly when home directory is unwritable.
Update pre-commit hook message for unsigned sessions on empty commits.
Remove redundant duplicate path filter in event handling.
Split post-task markdown and terminal reporting into section helpers.

Files changed: guard/agent/events.py, guard/core/session.py, guard/reporters/markdown.py, guard/reporters/terminal.py, guard/task_flow.py, tests/test_session_followups.py
